CustomField.description: Mail cycle schedule in business days (business hours Sales (NL): weekends and holidays skipped, Util_BusinessDays) after mail 1 (= the batch release), comma separated: one day per next mail, then the day the member is closed (Completed + Mail Completed Status + moved to the Follow-up Campaign). E.g. "3,8,14" with Max Attempts (Mail) 3: mail 2 on business day 3, mail 3 on business day 8, closed on business day 14. Must have Max Attempts (Mail) values. Empty = every Mail Interval (Days). Read by afl - CampaignMember - Mail Cycle.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Business days after mail 1 (weekends and Sales (NL) holidays skipped), comma separated: each next mail, then the closing day. E.g. 3,8,14 = mail 2 on business day 3, mail 3 on business day 8, closed on business day 14. Empty = Mail Interval (Days).
CustomField.label: Mail Schedule (Days)
